name: Charlie No-Face
description: A western-Pennsylvania urban legend about a faceless or 'green-skinned' figure walking rural roads at night. The legend is rooted in the real life of Raymond Theodore Robinson (1910–1985), severely disfigured by a 1919 electrical accident, who walked the country roads of Beaver County after dark for decades.

aliases.name: Raymond Robinson
aliases.meaning: the historical person whose life inspired the legend

origin: Western Pennsylvania, with the legend strongest in Beaver, Butler, and Allegheny counties; Robinson himself lived and walked principally in Beaver County.
